svg.title: From a source–sample sandwich to the lifetime spectrum
svg.desc: Two gamma rays leave the sandwich and deposit energy inside opposing scintillators. Light crosses the optical coupling and entrance window. At the photocathode an absorbed photon can release a photoelectron toward the first dynode. Separate coaxial cables carry the anode pulses to the digitizer. The laptop accumulates accepted start–stop time differences in the lifetime spectrum.
